title: Hamburger and Macaroni Hot Dish
description: This hamburger and macaroni hot dish recipe simmers the key ingredients in tomato soup and American cheese for a quick and easy hot weeknight dish.
ingredients: 1 pinch Italian seasoning, or to taste
1 pinch seasoned salt, or to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 minutes; drain.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and minced onion; cook and stir until almost browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Add garlic; cook until beef is browned, 2 to 3 minutes more. Drain; discard excess grease.
Stir macaroni, tomato soup, corn, Italian seasoning, and seasoned salt into ground beef mixture; top with American cheese slices. Cover skillet until cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes; stir well.
